title: 共軛焦顯微鏡~Confocal microscopy
focus: 針孔艾里單位、光學切片厚度、光子預算與雷射掃描系統的校正~Pinhole Airy units, optical-section thickness, photon budgets and calibration of laser-scanning systems
summary: 從點照明與點偵測的共軛關係推導針孔為何能排除離焦光，用艾里單位把針孔直徑、橫向解析度與光學切片厚度連起來，再把螢光光子預算、振鏡掃描時序、偵測器死時間、折射率失配與奈奎斯特取樣整合成一台可驗收的雷射掃描共軛焦顯微鏡。~Derive from the conjugate relation of point illumination and point detection why a pinhole rejects out-of-focus light, use Airy units to tie pinhole diameter to lateral resolution and optical-section thickness, then integrate the fluorescence photon budget, galvanometer timing, detector dead time, refractive-index mismatch and Nyquist sampling into an acceptable laser-scanning confocal microscope.

units.anchor: 共軛焦針孔與艾里斑~Confocal pinhole and Airy disc
units.title: 點照明、點偵測與光學切片~Point illumination, point detection and optical sectioning
units.mechanism: 共軛焦顯微鏡把雷射聚成一個繞射極限光點照明樣品，並在偵測路徑上與焦點共軛的位置放一個針孔；焦平面上的螢光成像在針孔中心通過，離焦平面的螢光在針孔處散成大斑而大部分被擋掉。系統點擴散函數是照明與偵測點擴散函數的乘積，因此橫向解析度略優於寬場，而沿光軸的訊號隨離焦距離快速衰減，形成光學切片。針孔直徑以艾里單位（AU）表示，1 AU 等於艾里斑第一暗環的直徑。~A confocal microscope focuses the laser to a diffraction-limited spot and places a pinhole in the detection path at a position conjugate to that focus; fluorescence from the focal plane passes through the pinhole centre, while light from out-of-focus planes spreads into a large patch at the pinhole and is mostly blocked. The system point-spread function is the product of the illumination and detection functions, so lateral resolution is slightly better than widefield and the axial signal decays quickly with defocus, producing an optical section. Pinhole diameter is quoted in Airy units, 1 AU being the diameter of the first dark ring of the Airy disc.
units.model: 1 AU = 1.22·λ_em/NA：λ_em = 520 nm、NA = 1.4 時為 0.453 µm（樣品面），在 63× 中間像面上為 28.6 µm。針孔 ≥ 1 AU 時橫向半高寬 ≈ 0.51·λ_exc/NA = 0.51×0.488/1.4 ≈ 0.178 µm。軸向半高寬 ≈ √{[0.88·λ_em/(n − √(n² − NA²))]² + [√2·n·PH/NA]²}，n = 1.518、PH = 1 AU 時 ≈ √(0.491² + 0.695²) ≈ 0.85 µm，PH = 2 AU 時 ≈ 1.47 µm。~1 AU = 1.22·λ_em/NA: for λ_em = 520 nm and NA = 1.4 it is 0.453 µm in the sample plane, or 28.6 µm at a 63× intermediate image. For a pinhole ≥ 1 AU the lateral FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ_exc/NA = 0.51×0.488/1.4 ≈ 0.178 µm. The axial FWHM ≈ √{[0.88·λ_em/(n − √(n² − NA²))]² + [√2·n·PH/NA]²}; with n = 1.518 and PH = 1 AU it is ≈ √(0.491² + 0.695²) ≈ 0.85 µm, and ≈ 1.47 µm at 2 AU.
units.verify: 以次解析度螢光珠（直徑 100 nm）取 z 疊層，沿 x 與 z 擬合高斯取得半高寬，與上述公式在 0.5、1、2 AU 三個針孔設定下的預測比較；同時記錄各設定的峰值訊號，確認切片厚度與訊號隨針孔的變化趨勢一致。~Acquire z-stacks of sub-resolution fluorescent beads (100 nm) and fit Gaussians along x and z to obtain FWHM values, comparing them with the predictions above at pinhole settings of 0.5, 1 and 2 AU; record the peak signal at each setting as well to confirm that section thickness and signal both follow the pinhole trend.
units.failure: 針孔開到 3 AU 以上追求亮度，離焦背景大量進入偵測器，切片厚度增加到數微米，厚樣品的影像退化成接近寬場的模糊疊加。~Opening the pinhole beyond 3 AU for brightness lets a large out-of-focus background reach the detector, section thickness grows to several micrometres, and images of thick samples degrade toward a widefield-like blur.
units.misconception: 針孔越小，影像在所有條件下都越清晰。~A smaller pinhole always gives a sharper image under every condition.

units.anchor: 螢光激發與光子計數~Fluorescence excitation and photon count
units.title: 螢光物理與單像素光子預算~Fluorescence physics and the per-pixel photon budget
units.mechanism: 螢光分子吸收激發光子後在奈秒內放出較長波長的光子，激發與發射的波長差（Stokes 位移）讓二向色鏡與發射濾鏡能把激發光擋掉。每個分子的發射速率受吸收截面、激發強度與激發態壽命限制，接近飽和強度時再加雷射功率只會加速光漂白。共軛焦的像素停留時間只有微秒，收集立體角、光學穿透率與偵測器量子效率又把到達偵測器的光子再砍一個數量級，因此每像素常只有數十個光子，散粒雜訊主導影像品質。~A fluorophore absorbs an excitation photon and within nanoseconds emits a longer-wavelength photon; the excitation-emission wavelength gap (Stokes shift) lets a dichroic and an emission filter block the excitation light. Each molecule's emission rate is limited by absorption cross-section, excitation intensity and excited-state lifetime, and near the saturation intensity more laser power only accelerates photobleaching. Confocal pixel dwell times are microseconds, and collection solid angle, optical transmission and detector quantum efficiency cut the photons reaching the detector by another order of magnitude, so a pixel often holds only tens of photons and shot noise governs image quality.
units.model: 吸收截面 σ = 3.82×10⁻²¹·ε cm²，ε = 80,000 M⁻¹cm⁻¹ 時 σ ≈ 3.1×10⁻¹⁶ cm²；壽命 3 ns 的飽和強度 I_sat = hν/(σ·τ) ≈ 4.07×10⁻¹⁹/(3.1×10⁻¹⁶×3×10⁻⁹) ≈ 4.4×10⁵ W/cm²。10 µW 聚焦到半徑 0.2 µm 的強度約 8×10³ W/cm²，為 I_sat 的 1.8%，每分子發射率 ≈ 0.8·σ·I/hν ≈ 4.8×10⁶ 光子/s，2 µs 停留約 9.6 個；收集效率 0.307×0.5×0.4 ≈ 6% 給 0.6 個偵測光子，100 個分子得 60 個光子，SNR ≈ 7.7。~The absorption cross-section is σ = 3.82×10⁻²¹·ε cm², so ε = 80,000 M⁻¹cm⁻¹ gives σ ≈ 3.1×10⁻¹⁶ cm²; with a 3 ns lifetime the saturation intensity I_sat = hν/(σ·τ) ≈ 4.07×10⁻¹⁹/(3.1×10⁻¹⁶×3×10⁻⁹) ≈ 4.4×10⁵ W/cm². Focusing 10 µW into a 0.2 µm radius gives about 8×10³ W/cm², 1.8% of I_sat, an emission rate per molecule ≈ 0.8·σ·I/hν ≈ 4.8×10⁶ photons/s, about 9.6 in a 2 µs dwell; a collection efficiency of 0.307×0.5×0.4 ≈ 6% leaves 0.6 detected photons, so 100 molecules give 60 photons and SNR ≈ 7.7.
units.verify: 在物鏡後用功率計量各雷射線的實際功率，用已知濃度的螢光素溶液與光子計數模式量每像素計數，對照上述預算；再做功率系列（1、2、4、8 倍）確認訊號在飽和前線性，並記錄漂白半衰期隨功率的變化。~Measure the actual power of each laser line after the objective with a power meter, count photons per pixel in photon-counting mode on a fluorescein solution of known concentration and compare with the budget above; then run a power series (1, 2, 4, 8 times) to confirm linearity below saturation and record how the bleaching half-life changes with power.
units.failure: 為了提高亮度把激發功率推到飽和區，發射率不再上升，光漂白與光毒性卻按功率增加，時序影像的訊號在數十幀內衰減到背景。~Pushing excitation power into saturation to gain brightness stops increasing emission, while photobleaching and phototoxicity keep rising with power, so a time series decays to background within tens of frames.
units.misconception: 雷射功率加倍，螢光訊號永遠加倍。~Doubling laser power always doubles the fluorescence signal.

units.anchor: 振鏡掃描器與掃描透鏡~Galvanometer scanners and scan lens
units.title: 掃描器、物鏡與視場取樣~Scanners, objective and field sampling
units.mechanism: 一對振鏡在物鏡後焦面的共軛位置偏轉光束，掃描透鏡與管鏡把角度轉成樣品面上的位置；振鏡在每條掃描線末端需要減速與回程，所以有效停留時間小於幀時間除以像素數。共振掃描器以固定頻率正弦掃描，速度快但每像素的停留時間只有數十奈秒，光子數大幅減少。物鏡的焦距（管鏡焦距除以放大率）與掃描半角決定最大視場，像素尺寸則由視場除以像素數決定，要達到奈奎斯特條件必須小於橫向半高寬的一半。~A galvanometer pair deflects the beam at a plane conjugate to the objective back focal plane, and the scan lens and tube lens convert angle into position on the sample; the mirrors must decelerate and fly back at each line end, so the effective dwell is less than frame time divided by pixel count. A resonant scanner oscillates sinusoidally at a fixed frequency, fast but with only tens of nanoseconds per pixel and far fewer photons. The objective focal length (tube-lens focal length over magnification) and scan half-angle set the maximum field, pixel size is field over pixel count, and Nyquist sampling requires it to be below half the lateral FWHM.
units.model: 63× 物鏡配 200 mm 管鏡，f_obj = 3.17 mm；瞳孔處掃描半角 ±2.5° 給視場 2×3.17×tan2.5° ≈ 277 µm。橫向半高寬 0.178 µm 的奈奎斯特像素 ≤ 0.089 µm，277 µm 需 3100 像素，1024 像素時像素 0.27 µm 欠取樣 3 倍，故需 3× 變焦到 92 µm 視場。振鏡 1 幀/s、512×512、70% 占空比時停留 ≈ 2.7 µs；8 kHz 共振掃描每行 62.5 µs，512 像素平均僅約 85 ns。~A 63× objective with a 200 mm tube lens has f_obj = 3.17 mm; a ±2.5° scan half-angle at the pupil gives a field of 2×3.17×tan2.5° ≈ 277 µm. Nyquist sampling of a 0.178 µm lateral FWHM needs pixels ≤ 0.089 µm, i.e. 3100 pixels across 277 µm; at 1024 pixels the 0.27 µm pixel undersamples by 3, so a 3× zoom to a 92 µm field is needed. A galvanometer at 1 frame/s, 512×512 and 70% duty gives a dwell ≈ 2.7 µs; an 8 kHz resonant scanner spends 62.5 µs per line, only about 85 ns per pixel on average over 512 pixels.
units.verify: 用載物台測微尺或 10 µm 週期的格線標板量各變焦下的像素尺寸與視場，檢查 x 與 y 比例是否一致、邊緣是否有正弦失真；以示波器量像素時脈與振鏡位置回授，確認停留時間與占空比符合設定。~Measure pixel size and field at several zoom settings with a stage micrometer or a 10 µm grid target, checking that x and y scales agree and that the edges show no sinusoidal distortion; probe the pixel clock and galvanometer position feedback with an oscilloscope to confirm dwell time and duty cycle match the settings.
units.failure: 以低變焦、1024 像素擷取整個視場再放大觀看，0.27 µm 的像素已把 0.18 µm 的細節混疊掉，事後任何去卷積都救不回來。~Capturing the whole field at low zoom with 1024 pixels and enlarging afterwards leaves 0.18 µm detail aliased by 0.27 µm pixels, and no later deconvolution can recover it.
units.misconception: 像素數越多，影像解析度就越高，與變焦無關。~More pixels always mean higher resolution regardless of zoom.

units.anchor: GaAsP 偵測器與針孔機構~GaAsP detector and pinhole mechanism
units.title: 針孔機構、偵測器與死時間~Pinhole mechanism, detectors and dead time
units.mechanism: 針孔是可變直徑的機械光闌，必須精確對準到偵測光路的共軛焦點，橫向偏差超過十分之一艾里單位就會損失訊號並使切片不對稱。偵測器從多鹼光電倍增管進展到 GaAsP 光陰極與混合式偵測器，量子效率從約 20% 提升到 40% 以上；光子計數模式消除增益雜訊，但每個脈衝後有死時間，計數率高時會漏計，需要修正或降低功率。光譜偵測以稜鏡或光柵把發射光分散到多陽極偵測器上，容許多染料的線性拆分。~The pinhole is a variable mechanical aperture that must sit precisely at the conjugate focus of the detection path; a lateral offset above a tenth of an Airy unit loses signal and skews the section. Detectors progressed from multialkali photomultipliers to GaAsP photocathodes and hybrid detectors, raising quantum efficiency from about 20% to above 40%; photon-counting mode removes gain noise but each pulse is followed by a dead time, so high count rates undercount and need correction or lower power. Spectral detection disperses the emission with a prism or grating onto a multi-anode detector, allowing linear unmixing of several dyes.
units.model: 63× 中間像面上 1 AU = 28.6 µm，對準容差 0.1 AU ≈ 2.9 µm。非麻痹型死時間修正 N_true = N_meas/(1 − N_meas·τ_d)：τ_d = 20 ns、真實率 5 MHz 時量到 5/(1 + 0.1) ≈ 4.55 MHz，漏計 9%；降到 1 MHz 時漏計只有 2%。GaAsP 量子效率 0.4 對多鹼 0.2，在同樣光子數下 SNR 提高 √2 ≈ 1.41 倍。~At a 63× intermediate image 1 AU = 28.6 µm, so the alignment tolerance of 0.1 AU is about 2.9 µm. Non-paralysable dead-time correction N_true = N_meas/(1 − N_meas·τ_d): with τ_d = 20 ns a true rate of 5 MHz is measured as 5/(1 + 0.1) ≈ 4.55 MHz, a 9% undercount, while at 1 MHz the loss is only 2%. GaAsP quantum efficiency of 0.4 versus 0.2 for multialkali raises SNR by √2 ≈ 1.41 for the same photon flux.
units.verify: 用反射模式與鏡面樣品掃描針孔 x、y 位置找到訊號峰值並記錄為對準基準；用穩定螢光片做功率系列，畫出計數率對功率曲線，從偏離線性的程度擬合死時間並確認修正後線性度在 2% 內。~In reflection mode with a mirror sample, scan the pinhole x and y positions to find the signal peak and log it as the alignment reference; with a stable fluorescent slide run a power series, plot count rate against power, fit the dead time from the departure from linearity and confirm that corrected linearity is within 2%.
units.failure: 針孔偏離共軛焦點 0.3 AU，訊號損失超過 30% 且軸向響應不對稱，使用者誤以為樣品染色不足而提高雷射功率，加速漂白。~A pinhole 0.3 AU off the conjugate focus loses more than 30% of the signal with an asymmetric axial response, and the user, believing the staining is weak, raises laser power and accelerates bleaching.
units.misconception: 光子計數模式在任何計數率下都是線性的。~Photon-counting mode is linear at any count rate.

units.anchor: 螢光珠 PSF 與格線標板~Fluorescent-bead PSF and grid target
units.title: 點擴散函數、比例尺與色差校正~PSF, scale and chromatic calibration
units.mechanism: 校正分三個層次：橫向比例尺用已知週期的格線標板；三維點擴散函數用次解析度螢光珠，量半高寬並與理論比較以判斷物鏡、針孔與對準狀態；多通道配準用多色螢光珠量各波長之間的橫向與軸向偏移。物鏡的軸向色差在 488 與 640 nm 之間常有一到數百奈米，若不校正，雙色共定位會出現假陽性或假陰性。~Calibration has three layers: lateral scale with a grid target of known pitch; the three-dimensional point-spread function with sub-resolution fluorescent beads, measuring FWHM against theory to judge objective, pinhole and alignment; and multichannel registration with multicolour beads to measure lateral and axial offsets between wavelengths. Axial chromatic aberration of an objective between 488 and 640 nm is often one to several hundred nanometres, and without correction two-colour colocalization yields false positives or negatives.
units.model: 100 nm 珠在 63×/1.4、1 AU 下量到橫向半高寬 0.21 µm、軸向 0.98 µm，對理論 0.178 與 0.85 µm 的比值為 1.18 與 1.15，均在 1.2 的允收線內。10 µm 格線量到 10.05 µm 表示比例尺偏 0.5%，在 277 µm 視場上累積 1.4 µm 誤差；488 與 640 nm 通道軸向偏移量到 150 nm，需以校正檔平移後再做共定位分析。~A 100 nm bead at 63×/1.4 and 1 AU measures 0.21 µm laterally and 0.98 µm axially, ratios of 1.18 and 1.15 to the theoretical 0.178 and 0.85 µm, both inside the 1.2 acceptance line. A 10 µm grid read as 10.05 µm is a 0.5% scale error, accumulating 1.4 µm across a 277 µm field; an axial offset of 150 nm measured between the 488 and 640 nm channels must be shifted out with a calibration file before colocalization analysis.
units.verify: 每個物鏡與每組雷射線各取一次珠子 z 疊層，記錄三軸半高寬與通道偏移；每月以格線標板重量比例尺，趨勢偏離超過 0.3% 時檢查掃描器校正；校正檔附日期與條件存入系統。~For each objective and laser set acquire one bead z-stack and record the three-axis FWHM values and channel offsets; re-measure the scale monthly with the grid target and inspect scanner calibration when the trend drifts beyond 0.3%; store calibration files with date and conditions in the system.
units.failure: 使用過大的 500 nm 珠子量點擴散函數，量到的半高寬被珠子尺寸撐大，誤判物鏡劣化並送修；或未做色差配準就宣稱兩種蛋白共定位。~Measuring the point-spread function with oversized 500 nm beads inflates the FWHM with the bead size, leading to a false diagnosis of objective degradation and an unnecessary repair; or claiming colocalization of two proteins without chromatic registration.
units.misconception: 廠商規格書上的解析度就是這台顯微鏡現在的解析度。~The resolution in the vendor datasheet is this microscope's resolution today.

units.anchor: 折射率失配與軸向比例~Refractive-index mismatch and axial scaling
units.title: 折射率失配、球差與軸向誤差預算~Index mismatch, spherical aberration and the axial error budget
units.mechanism: 油鏡設計用於折射率 1.518 的介質，當焦點進入折射率 1.33 的水性樣品時，光線在蓋玻片界面折射，焦點移動量小於載物台位移，影像在 z 方向被拉長；同時邊緣光線與近軸光線的焦點分離，產生隨深度增加的球差，軸向點擴散函數變寬、峰值下降。軸向量測的誤差預算因此包含比例因子（系統誤差）、球差造成的半高寬展寬、z 步進的量化與載物台重複性。~An oil objective is designed for a medium of index 1.518; when the focus enters an aqueous sample of index 1.33, rays refract at the coverslip interface, the focus moves less than the stage, and the image is stretched along z; at the same time marginal and paraxial rays focus apart, producing spherical aberration that grows with depth, broadening the axial point-spread function and lowering its peak. The axial error budget therefore holds a scale factor (systematic), aberration-induced broadening, z-step quantization and stage repeatability.
units.model: 近軸焦點位移比 ≈ n_sample/n_imm = 1.33/1.518 = 0.876：載物台移動 10 µm 時焦點只深入 8.76 µm，厚 10 µm 的結構在影像中顯示為 11.4 µm，未修正即為 14% 的系統誤差。以 0.43 µm 的 z 步進，量化誤差約 ±0.12 µm；在水中 30 µm 深處球差使軸向半高寬由 0.85 µm 展寬到約 1.7 µm，是淺層的兩倍。~The paraxial focal-shift ratio ≈ n_sample/n_imm = 1.33/1.518 = 0.876: a 10 µm stage move takes the focus only 8.76 µm deeper, so a 10 µm thick structure appears 11.4 µm in the image, a 14% systematic error if uncorrected. With a 0.43 µm z-step the quantization error is about ±0.12 µm; at 30 µm into water, spherical aberration broadens the axial FWHM from 0.85 µm to roughly 1.7 µm, twice the shallow value.
units.verify: 把螢光珠固定在水性凝膠中不同深度，量各深度的軸向半高寬與峰值，畫出隨深度的退化曲線；用已知厚度的夾層樣品比較影像厚度與真實厚度，得出實際比例因子並與 0.876 比較，決定是否改用水鏡或矽油鏡。~Fix fluorescent beads at several depths in an aqueous gel, measure axial FWHM and peak at each depth and plot the degradation curve; compare the imaged thickness of a spacer sample of known thickness with its true value to obtain the actual scale factor, compare with 0.876, and decide whether a water or silicone-oil objective is required.
units.failure: 用油鏡量活細胞體積而未修正軸向比例，所有體積高估約 14%；深層的球差又讓細胞底部訊號消失，三維重建出現不存在的錐形。~Measuring live-cell volume with an oil objective without axial-scale correction overestimates every volume by about 14%; spherical aberration at depth also erases the signal at the cell base and the 3D reconstruction shows a cone that does not exist.
units.misconception: 載物台移動多少，焦點在樣品內就移動多少。~The focus moves inside the sample by exactly the stage displacement.

units.anchor: Z 疊層時序與雷射劑量表~Z-stack timing and laser-dose table
units.title: 系統整合、取樣策略與劑量管理~System integration, sampling strategy and dose management
units.mechanism: 整合階段要把雷射合併與 AOTF 功率控制、掃描時序、針孔、偵測器與 z 驅動統一在一個擷取流程裡，並依奈奎斯特條件決定 x、y、z 取樣。共軛焦在擷取每一層時，整個雙錐照明體積都被曝光，所以厚樣品的每個體素會被照射到次數等於層數，劑量管理必須把層數、通道數與幀平均一起算進去；時序影像還要在訊號雜訊比與漂白之間決定幀間隔。~Integration unifies laser combining with AOTF power control, scan timing, pinhole, detectors and the z-drive in one acquisition pipeline, with x, y and z sampling fixed by Nyquist. Because the whole double-cone illumination volume is exposed while each slice is acquired, every voxel of a thick sample is irradiated as many times as there are slices, so dose management must count slices, channels and frame averaging together; a time series must also balance signal-to-noise against bleaching when choosing the frame interval.
units.model: 軸向半高寬 0.85 µm 的奈奎斯特 z 步進 ≤ 0.43 µm，20 µm 厚樣品需 47 層。1024×1024、停留 2 µs 加回程約 2.5 s/幀，單通道疊層約 2 分鐘，三通道依序擷取約 6 分鐘；每個體素被照射 47 次，若線平均 2 次則劑量加倍而 SNR 只升 √2 ≈ 1.41 倍。~Nyquist z-step for a 0.85 µm axial FWHM is ≤ 0.43 µm, so a 20 µm thick sample needs 47 slices. At 1024×1024 with 2 µs dwell plus fly-back, about 2.5 s per frame, a single-channel stack takes about 2 minutes and three sequential channels about 6 minutes; each voxel is irradiated 47 times, and line averaging by 2 doubles the dose while raising SNR only by √2 ≈ 1.41.
units.verify: 以均勻螢光片在設定的雷射功率下連續擷取並擬合漂白曲線，得出每幀的衰減率；把擷取計畫（層數、通道、平均次數）代入估算整個實驗的總衰減，並與實際樣品的首尾幀訊號比較以驗證劑量模型。~On a uniform fluorescent slide at the planned laser power acquire continuously and fit the bleaching curve to obtain the per-frame decay; insert the acquisition plan (slices, channels, averages) to estimate total decay across the experiment and compare with first-to-last frame signal on the real sample to validate the dose model.
units.failure: 為了漂亮的影像用 4 次幀平均加 0.2 µm 的過細 z 步進，劑量比必要值高 8 倍，活細胞在疊層完成前已停止分裂，實驗結果被光毒性而非生物學決定。~Using 4-frame averaging and an over-fine 0.2 µm z-step for prettier images raises the dose 8 times above necessary; live cells stop dividing before the stack finishes and phototoxicity, not biology, decides the result.
units.misconception: 共軛焦只照亮焦平面，所以離焦的樣品不會被漂白。~A confocal illuminates only the focal plane, so out-of-focus sample is never bleached.

units.anchor: 驗收矩陣與校正檔~Acceptance matrix and calibration files
units.title: 驗收測試矩陣與工程交接~Acceptance test matrix and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 驗收以測試矩陣進行：每個物鏡的三維點擴散函數、視場照度均勻性、通道配準、每條雷射線在樣品面的功率與穩定度、偵測器線性與死時間、載物台與 z 驅動重複性。每項設定允收門檻並附量測方法，結果與校正檔、韌體與軟體版本一起歸檔；交接文件還需記載針孔對準基準、AOTF 功率對照表與已知限制（例如深層水性樣品需水鏡），使後續使用者能判斷系統狀態是否仍在驗收範圍內。~Acceptance follows a test matrix: three-dimensional point-spread function per objective, field illumination uniformity, channel registration, power and stability of each laser line at the sample plane, detector linearity and dead time, and stage and z-drive repeatability. Each item carries an acceptance threshold and a measurement method, and results are archived with calibration files and firmware and software versions; the handoff record also lists the pinhole alignment reference, the AOTF power lookup table and known limits such as the need for a water objective in deep aqueous samples, so later users can judge whether the system still sits inside its accepted range.
units.model: 允收門檻範例：點擴散函數半高寬 ≤ 1.2× 理論值（1 AU 軸向量到 0.98 µm 對 0.85 µm 為 1.15，通過）；視場中心對邊緣照度比 ≥ 0.9；通道配準橫向 ≤ 100 nm、軸向 ≤ 200 nm；雷射功率 10 次量測標準差 ≤ 2%（10.0 µW ± 0.15 µW 為 1.5%，通過）；z 驅動重複性 ≤ 0.1 µm。~Example thresholds: point-spread FWHM ≤ 1.2× theory (an axial 0.98 µm at 1 AU against 0.85 µm is 1.15, pass); centre-to-edge illumination ratio ≥ 0.9; channel registration ≤ 100 nm lateral and ≤ 200 nm axial; laser-power standard deviation over 10 readings ≤ 2% (10.0 µW ± 0.15 µW is 1.5%, pass); z-drive repeatability ≤ 0.1 µm.
units.verify: 依矩陣逐項量測並填入結果與通過／不通過，照度均勻性用厚螢光片的單幀影像計算邊緣對中心比，載物台重複性以同一珠子往返 10 次定位的標準差評估；全部完成後由使用方與交付方共同簽署並存檔。~Measure every item of the matrix and record result and pass or fail, computing illumination uniformity as the edge-to-centre ratio of a single frame of a thick fluorescent slide and stage repeatability as the standard deviation of 10 return positions on one bead; on completion both user and supplier sign and archive the record.
units.failure: 驗收只做一次示範影像而沒有量化矩陣，半年後偵測器增益漂移與針孔偏移同時出現，沒有基準可以比較，只能憑印象說「影像變差了」。~Accepting on a single demonstration image without a quantitative matrix leaves no baseline when detector-gain drift and pinhole offset appear together six months later, and the only available statement is that the images look worse.
units.misconception: 示範影像漂亮就代表系統通過驗收。~A beautiful demonstration image means the system has passed acceptance.

example: 取樣與針孔練習：63×/1.4 油鏡、λ_exc = 488 nm、λ_em = 520 nm、n = 1.518。1 AU = 1.22×0.52/1.4 = 0.453 µm，在 63× 中間像面為 28.6 µm 的針孔直徑。橫向半高寬 0.51×0.488/1.4 ≈ 0.178 µm，1 AU 軸向半高寬 ≈ √(0.491² + 0.695²) ≈ 0.85 µm；奈奎斯特像素 ≤ 0.089 µm、z 步進 ≤ 0.43 µm，1024 像素對應 92 µm 視場，20 µm 厚的細胞需 47 層。艾里斑第一暗環內含 84% 的能量、第二暗環內含 91%，所以針孔從 1 AU 開到 2 AU 只多收 8% 的焦內訊號，卻把軸向半高寬從 0.85 µm 拉到 1.47 µm，並讓離焦光通過面積增為 4 倍；縮到 0.5 AU 時只剩約 59% 的焦內能量，訊號損失 30% 而解析度僅小幅改善。因此 1 AU 是訊號與切片的常用折衷。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Sampling and pinhole exercise: 63×/1.4 oil objective, λ_exc = 488 nm, λ_em = 520 nm, n = 1.518. 1 AU = 1.22×0.52/1.4 = 0.453 µm, which is a 28.6 µm pinhole at the 63× intermediate image. Lateral FWHM 0.51×0.488/1.4 ≈ 0.178 µm and axial FWHM at 1 AU ≈ √(0.491² + 0.695²) ≈ 0.85 µm; Nyquist pixel ≤ 0.089 µm and z-step ≤ 0.43 µm, so 1024 pixels span a 92 µm field and a 20 µm thick cell needs 47 slices. The first dark ring of the Airy pattern encloses 84% of the energy and the second 91%, so opening the pinhole from 1 to 2 AU gains only 8% in-focus signal while stretching the axial FWHM from 0.85 to 1.47 µm and quadrupling the area open to out-of-focus light; closing to 0.5 AU keeps only about 59% of the in-focus energy, a 30% signal loss for a small resolution gain. Hence 1 AU is the usual compromise between signal and sectioning. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: Marvin Minsky 於 1957 年申請共軛焦掃描顯微鏡專利，以點照明與針孔偵測排除離焦光；1980 年代中期 Amos、White 與 Fordham 等人結合雷射、振鏡與電腦影像，使雷射掃描共軛焦成為生物學標準工具，Zeiss 與 Bio-Rad 隨後推出商用系統。1990 年代轉盤式（Nipkow disk）共軛焦提高了活細胞成像速度，2010 年代的陣列偵測器（如 Airyscan 概念）則在不犧牲訊號下把解析度推過針孔極限。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。~Marvin Minsky filed the confocal scanning microscope patent in 1957, rejecting out-of-focus light with point illumination and pinhole detection; in the mid-1980s Amos, White, Fordham and others combined lasers, galvanometers and computer imaging to make laser-scanning confocal a standard biological tool, and Zeiss and Bio-Rad soon offered commercial systems. In the 1990s spinning-disk (Nipkow disk) confocals raised live-cell imaging speed, and in the 2010s array detectors such as the Airyscan concept pushed resolution past the pinhole limit without sacrificing signal. This course rebuilds only public principles and engineering logic.
